risk: Scope growth delays the Core vertical slice
mitigation: Gate every phase; defer Advanced/Stretch until Core end-to-end path passes.

risk: LLM produces plausible but unsupported factual explanations
mitigation: Approved-source-only evidence; deterministic adjudication; UNVERIFIABLE abstention; golden tests.

risk: Temporal or scope metadata selects an inapplicable fact
mitigation: Explicit valid-time and scope fields; boundary tests for dates, regions, channels and products.

risk: Uploaded prompt injection changes worker behaviour
mitigation: Treat upload strings as data; isolated prompts; read-only allowlisted tools; no execution of document instructions.

risk: Cross-workspace data leakage through files, vectors or evidence
mitigation: Default-deny authorization before retrieval; brand-scoped repositories; negative access tests; RLS defence-in-depth.

risk: OCR/parser misses text or gives misleading coordinates
mitigation: Store extraction confidence and warnings; preserve source; manual inspection route; parser regression fixtures.

risk: Provider outage or rate limit blocks review
mitigation: Deterministic/mock path, bounded retries, timeout budgets and explicit PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE state.

risk: Duplicate job execution creates duplicate findings
mitigation: Idempotency keys, unique constraints, leases and worker-restart tests.

risk: Patch offsets are applied to changed content
mitigation: Bind patch to base hash and offsets; reject stale patch; create new immutable version.

risk: UI displays APPROVED while backend is pending or failed
mitigation: Backend-owned state only; typed state machine; frontend never infers approval.

risk: Synthetic demo data is mistaken for real brand evidence
mitigation: Clearly label ORBITA corpus as fictional and test-only in UI, fixtures and demo script.

risk: Unverified event rules invalidate reuse or external service choices
mitigation: Complete event integrity checklist against official rules before submission; retain source/date evidence.

risk: Provider terms or licence do not permit intended data processing
mitigation: Provider register and dependency licence inventory; do not activate unverified provider.

risk: Historical approval becomes uninterpretable after policy/model changes
mitigation: Version all content, pack, policy, model, prompt and configuration context; immutable audit receipt.

risk: Logs expose raw content, source snippets, prompts or storage credentials
mitigation: Structured metadata-only logs; secret scanning; redaction tests; scoped short-lived file grants.
